correctness.rationale: The projective tensor crossnorm on elementary tensors gives an exact linear isometry Theta:Z=d(w,1)->l_infty((Z completed_tensor_pi Z)**) via Theta(v)_n=J(e_n tensor v). For each nonzero v the normalized coordinates form an isometric 1-symmetric weakly null copy of the Lorentz basis. The Lorentz dual coefficient majorization dominated by w gives l_q evaluations for every q with sum w_n^q finite, including q=r in the logarithmically corrected first weight. For other q, the proof invokes the specific hereditary obstruction [Sliwa, Theorem 3.1] and explicitly checks its H1 via Hahn–Banach restriction to the hereditarily-l1 tensor fiber and H2 via weak-star/weak equivalence on the canonical bidual embedding. This excludes forbidden q for all normalized subsequences and blocks. Integral comparison gives A_w=[r,infinity) for every r>1, or empty, and the tensor isometry turns single realizations into an entire closed infinite-dimensional space. The nonstandard input is imported, not newly reproved; its full original preprint was inaccessible at this run and is an explicit residual verification limitation.
